name: gocpp
description: gocpp language support for .gp files: syntax highlighting and the gocpp language server

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the gocpp language server does not start (it runs the C++ compiler on the headers of the project), and the settings gocpp.path, gocpp.lsp.args and gocpp.lsp.env come from your user settings only. Syntax highlighting works.

semanticTokenTypes.description: The name of a C/C++ header package, such as raylib in raylib.InitWindow
A C++ namespace, such as std or fs
A name from C/C++: after a header package or a namespace, or a member of a C/C++ value

gocpp.path.markdownDescription: The gocpp binary that runs the language server (`gocpp lsp`): a command name looked up in `PATH`, or a path. `~` at the start is your home directory; a relative path is relative to the first workspace folder.

gocpp.lsp.args.markdownDescription: More arguments for `gocpp lsp`, after `lsp`. For example `["-logfile", "/tmp/gocpp-lsp.log"]` writes the server log to a file.

gocpp.lsp.env.markdownDescription: Environment variables for the language server, on top of the environment of VS Code. A changed `PATH` is also used to find `gocpp.path`.

enumDescriptions: Trace the name of each message.
Trace each message with its content.
gocpp.trace.server.markdownDescription: Trace the messages between VS Code and the language server in the **gocpp** output channel.
